descriptor: Waterproof outdoor shells and packs, repaired for life

voice.summary: Granite Peak speaks like an experienced guide: short sentences, physical detail and no glorifying of suffering. It promises repair and warmth, then gets out of the way.
dos: Name weights, fabrics and seams exactly
Tell people how to repair it, not just buy it
Keep adventure talk modest and practical
donts: Do not use conquer or crush mountain metaphors
Never sell fear of the weather

boilerplate: Granite Peak makes waterproof shells and packs for long days in the hills and offers lifetime repair, so every piece is kept in use for as long as possible.

microcopy.success: Repair booked. We will send a label.
microcopy.error: Could not add that. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: Nothing in the shop in that size.

logo.note: A peak mark is the obvious shorthand, drawn simply enough to sit on a jacket sleeve.
